principle: No data about users is collected beyond what abuse prevention and matching need. No identity verification: people stay anonymous to the service and to each other. Tests fail if a profile field is added without a declared purpose here.

purposes.matching: Needed to find and rank compatible people.
purposes.abuse_prevention: Needed to keep people safe: age, catfishing, scams, harassment, exploitation.
purposes.service: Needed for a feature the person uses (login, language, their own profile shown to matches).
purposes.consent_record: Proof that the person agreed to optional sensitive answers.
purposes.calibration: Opt-in, de-identified improvement of the matcher (lib/calibration.mjs).

transient_only.check_selfie: Compared with the profile photo and used for an age estimate, then deleted immediately.
transient_only.connection_country: Compared with the declared country at sign-in; only the mismatch flag is kept.
transient_only.photo_metadata: Stripped (including GPS) before screening and storage.

retention.account: Deleted completely when the person deletes the account or both people in a couple leave together.
retention.messages: Deleted permanently 15 days after sending (messaging-policy retention), including from backups via per-day key destruction; reported or held messages only until the case is closed.
retention.reports: Only the reported messages and the decision, deleted after the case is closed and any legal hold has ended.
retention.banned_photo_hashes: Perceptual hash only, kept to stop the same photo being reused after a ban.
retention.calibration_records: De-identified; no link back to any account.

login: Passkeys, or an email address used only for login and recovery; never shown, shared or used for anything else.
